newsitem.title: SPAIN: B/Spain's Rojo says inflation reaching its floor.
newsitem.headline: B/Spain's Rojo says inflation reaching its floor.

text.p: Bank of Spain Governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Wednesday that Spanish inflation was reaching its floor.
Spanish inflation moderated to 1.7 percent in April, just more than half the rate of 3.2 percent in December 1996.
"In sum, following a rapid, sharp reduction in the inflation rate we are reaching what could be reasonably considered the bottom of that decline," Rojo said.
Earlier, Rojo said he expected inflation to be below two percent at year end, a more optimistic figure than the government's 2.2 percent target.
As a result, Rojo sees little scope for further declines in the rate this year, with the possiblity of a slight rebound in summer.
